entities.summary: Adriaan van den Spiegel, name sometimes written as Adrianus Spigelius, was a Flemish anatomist born in Brussels. For much of his career he practiced medicine in Padua, and is considered one of the great physicians associated with the city. At Padua he studied anatomy under Girolamo Fabrici. Adriaan van den Spiegel was a logicians & mathematicians from Brussels (1578, Brussels–1625-04-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
